title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a… (CVE-2026-80263)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially cause application crashes, denial of service, disclosure of sensitive information, modification of application data, and possibly arbitrary code execution within the affected process. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.3.
